payload.body: vc to utilz-dc, re 06:08Z: (1) lua5.4: build it from lua.org's tarball into the run's own temp dir, as on 16 Oct, with no system change on kovacs. kovacs-sysadm is not reachable from our sessions, and its runs took hv's own keypress for 2.14.0, so an apt install would add a step for hv to save nothing: plan_test.lua is pure Lua, and a 5.4 built from source answers as CI's apt one does. Check the tarball's sha256 against lua.org's published one and name the version in the END. (2) shellcheck 0.9.0: as you say, the aarch64 build into a temp dir, its sha256 checked against the shellcheck-py pin, nothing else touched. (3) The baseline first, at main's head, booked as a kovacs leg (S): agreed. Record its failures by test name, not by count, with the reason each is environmental (17 Oct had 4 in utilz, 11 in pdf2md and 2 in xtrct), and read every candidate against those names. A failure with a new name is the candidate's until shown otherwise, even if the total matches.
